THE PLAY MOST AGAINST ME, and I ran it as the step-5 pre-mortem: weekend.carry_realization_flip. It triggers - Friday closed on an unrealized warming driver (the Friday-close ladder rose 11.94 -> 13.14 -> 14.01 -> 14.54 into Monday) - and its call on a driver realizing over the weekend or on Monday is SELL-THE-NEWS REVERSAL, not extension. My CDD ladder peaks TODAY at 17.006 and falls every horizon after (14.69 Tue, 13.32 Wed, 12.21 Thu, 11.72 Fri), so the driver realizes on my day and the play points DOWN. I did not flip on it, for three named reasons, and I want the reasons on the record because this is the single most likely way my sign is wrong. (i) Its own traced record is 1-of-4, below chance, and its falsifier text says so. (ii) Its falsifier text ALSO flags precisely my regime as out of scope until a build lands: 'run the peak-ahead test on the burn RESIDUAL (grid_stack est_gas_burn net of wind/solar) rather than gross CDD... If it does, the play needs a residual limb before it may be applied in a renewables-heavy summer regime.' That residual limb does not exist and my day is a renewables-heavy summer day. (iii) Read on the FRIDAY-CLOSE forecast, which is what the play specifies, the peak was not the weekend at all - the Friday-close ladder read Mon 14.54, Tue 14.29, Wed 14.54, a plateau, and the weekend was the ramp INTO it. What actually happened across the seam is that the heat was PULLED FORWARD onto Monday and the back half was TRIMMED (Wednesday cut from a Friday-close 14.54 to 13.32, Thursday from 13.66 to 12.21) - a reshaping, not a realization. So I let the play shape my PATH (the give-back from +195 to +160 through the settle window) rather than my SIGN, and I record that if this day prints red, this play is why and it should be upgraded on the evidence.

THE SECOND-STRONGEST CASE AGAINST ME is not a play but an arithmetic fact from my own chain: the component of the seam revision at the horizons a SEPTEMBER contract actually values is +0.051 at D+2 and -0.677 at D+3. If the market prices the strip rather than the day, my sign is wrong. I hold UP because the front add (+2.90 across D+0 and D+1) is more than four times the size of the strip cut, because the damper that would neutralise it is measurably absent (wind -16.4% w/w rather than rising), and because the day's own realized regime is the block's hottest by +4.1 gw-CDD over Friday. I hold it SMALL for exactly the reason the bear case is good.

So, as the play demands, explicitly: THE DAY'S OWN DRIVERS DO NOT SUPPORT MORE THAN THIS. The revision is front-loaded onto two July days on a September leg; the strip component is zero-to-negative; the impact regime suppresses the net; the authority channel is null; there is no book; and the Friday handed forward nothing. The one path to a much larger number is short-covering into a thin book off a 14th-percentile futures book and a 0.94-percentile ICE book with both worsening - that is a TAIL I have named and banded to +800, and per positioning.covering_self_limiting_cot_wow_gate's own scope it has no p50 authority. I am not silently emitting the cap; I am saying the derivation genuinely stops here.
